newsitem.title: EGYPT: Mohandes Insurance H1 96/7 profit $1.5 mln.
newsitem.headline: Mohandes Insurance H1 96/7 profit $1.5 mln.

text.p: Mohandes Insurance made net profits of 5.1 million pounds ($1.5 million) in the first six months of the 1996/7 financial year, a company statement published on Sunday showed.
The statement did not give figures for the same period of the previous year but said the firm made net profits of 7.3 million pounds for the whole of 1995/6.
The financial year begins on July 1.
The firm's 2.2 million shares are held by a small group of investors and are rarely traded on the Egyptian stock exchange. They last traded on April 16 and closed at 45 pounds.
